core.title: Design Review Runs On The Design Page
core.core: Design review runs on #/design (ui/views/design.js): real helpers on fixtures, notes via `shelf note --file ~/.aleph/annotations.json`, not vibe-annotations.

core.title: Design Options Are Shown As Rendered HTML Mocks
core.core: Show design options as rendered HTML mocks (docs/mocks/), opened in the browser.

core.title: Work Mode Is Set Per Session And Defaults To Factory
core.core: Work mode is per session: /aleph:mode factory|solo, default factory; the set mode beats every other rule.

core.title: UI Text Is Terse
core.core: UI text is terse: empty() shows "No data"; notes are 1-2 words. [[UI Text Is Terse]]

core.title: Grill Questions Explain In Prose And Decide In The Question UI
core.core: Grill one question at a time: explain options and the recommendation in prose, then decide through AskUserQuestion.

core.title: Issues Have Four Priorities And A Parked Status
core.core: Issues have four priorities that order the factory's work; parked stops new work, not a running job.

core.title: Terminal Lists Link Each Issue And Job
core.core: Every issue or job named in a reply links to aleph.home (#/issues/<repo>/<n>, #/jobs/<name>); each choice offered gets a brief description. [[Terminal Lists Link Each Issue And Job]]

core.title: Factory Agents Get AGENT.md Instead Of Chris's CLAUDE.md
core.core: Factory agents run with ALEPH_AGENT; they load identity/AGENT.md, not ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md or MEMORY.md, and write only where the brief says.

core.title: Live Pages Refetch On A Pushed Change Signal
core.core: The UI pushes a `change` signal on /api/events and live pages refetch; no data diffs. refresh is a quiet timer. [[Live Pages Refetch On A Pushed Change Signal]]

core.title: UI Charts Are Frame Panels And Component State Goes Through keep
core.core: A UI chart is an <aleph-chart> panel drawn from a frame (ui/chart.js); per-component view state goes through keep()/kept() in ui/lib.js.

core.title: Aleph IDs Are Short Codes, Flat Issues And Numbered Jobs
core.core: IDs are short (a1430, a1430#2), sub-issues are flat with from:, events are one-word action and sub plus fields; lib/naming.ts owns them.

core.title: Chris Wants Minimal Beautiful Code With Short Names
core.core: Code is minimal and good to look at; names are short, two characters or more outside a loop or comprehension. Rules: the Style section of aleph:write-code.

core.title: The Aleph Readme Is Plain And Impersonal
core.core: The aleph README is plain and impersonal (no first person, no quotes of Chris, no PRINCIPLES link) and goes header, features, quick start, development, docs.

core.title: Worker-Low Runs On DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
core.core: worker-low runs on deepseek-v4.1-flash (Chris, 2026-11-05); mimo and minimax were shadowed and rejected.

core.title: Aleph Rebuild Removes The Sandbox Hidden Checks And Pre-Work Runs
core.core: The factory rebuild removes the srt sandbox, the Chrome workaround, hidden checks, acceptance and all but one pre-work run.

core.title: Blog Posts Use The Writer's Voice Not STE
core.core: STE is for chat, commits, docs and comments; blog posts, essays and letters keep the writer's voice and go through aleph:humanizer.

core.title: Issue Titles Are Imperative And At Most 60 Characters
core.core: An issue title is one imperative of at most 60 characters that says what changes, not how, with no final period.

core.title: Flake Follow-Ups Are Paused
core.core: Flake follow-ups are paused: flakes go only to notes on aleph-1156, and nobody files a flake issue.

core.title: Every Needs-You Item Gets An Always Button
core.core: Every item that needs Chris gets an Always button that records a standing permission, so the factory stops asking.

core.title: One Proxy Owns Port 80 For Every Home Name
core.core: Every .home name on Lightbox2 goes to port 80; home-proxy.service picks the app by the Host header.

core.title: modal-lib Runs Modal Jobs For Every Project
core.core: Modal GPU jobs in every project use modal-lib v2 (~/modal-lib).

core.title: Design Docs Lead With Decisions And Stay Short
core.core: Design docs and specs lead with decisions and their reasons and stay short; detail only what the next milestone builds.

core.title: Docker Runs Natively In WSL Under Systemd
core.core: Docker is the systemd unit docker in WSL; fix a missing daemon with sudo systemctl start docker, never with Docker Desktop.

core.title: The Vault Pushes To A Private Remote
core.core: Every vault op that commits pushes to the private repo crsmithdev/aleph-vault.

core.title: Design Options Are Shown As Rendered HTML Mocks
